name: Conrad Maldives Rangali Island
insider_take: The world's first underwater hotel restaurant meets overwater villa paradise in this dual-island luxury escape.
whats_special: Conrad Maldives spans two private islands connected by a 500-meter bridge - the only resort in the Maldives with this unique twin-island design. Home to Ithaa, the world's first all-glass undersea restaurant sitting 16 feet below sea level, offering 270-degree panoramic views of vibrant coral gardens while dining on contemporary European cuisine.
pro_tip: Book Ithaa restaurant well in advance - this underwater dining experience only seats 14 guests and is consistently voted one of the world's most unique restaurants. Sunset dinner reservations offer the most magical lighting through the glass dome.
dont_miss: The overwater spa treatment rooms with glass floor panels for fish-watching during massages, night snorkeling with nurse sharks and stingrays in the resort's lagoon, and the world's largest wine cellar selection in the Maldives featuring over 20,000 bottles stored 20 feet underground.
pros: World's first underwater restaurant offering unique dining experience
Overwater and beach villas with private pools and direct ocean access
Two pristine islands connected by bridge with diverse accommodation options
Exceptional snorkeling and diving with house reef and marine life
